markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: wish 说的是**和现实相反的愿望**。秘诀是**往过去退一步**：想要现在不一样，用过去时；后悔过去，用 had done。If only 意思一样，语气更强。

uses.en_zh: 要是我有更多时间就好了。（现在没有）
要是我早点走就好了。（当时没早走）

present.title: 希望现在不一样
present.rule: 说**现在**的事，退一步用过去时。I wish I had a car = 可惜我现在没车。be 动词常用 were。

examples.zh: 要是我知道答案就好了。

examples.en: I [[wish]] I [[lived]] closer to the office.
examples.zh: 要是我住得离公司近点就好了。
要是今天是周五就好了。
要是我会说法语就好了。

notes: was 和 were 都可以：聊天常说 I wish it was…，正式一点用 were。
can 退一步变 could，will 退一步变 would。

past.title: 后悔过去
past.rule: 说**过去**的事，退一步用 had + 过去分词，意思是「要是当时……就好了」。这就是后悔。

examples.en: I [[wish]] I [[had backed up]] my files.
examples.zh: 要是我之前备份了文件就好了。

examples.en: I [[wish]] we [[hadn't released]] it on a Friday.
examples.zh: 要是我们没在周五发布就好了。
她后悔当初没接那份工作。

would.title: 希望别人改一改
would.rule: 对**别人或某件事**不满意，希望它变，用 would + 原形，带点抱怨。说自己不能用 I wish I would。

examples.zh: 真希望你能回一下我的邮件。
构建能快点跑完就好了。

wrong.bad: I wish ~~I would~~ have more time.

ifonly.title: If only：语气更强
ifonly.rule: If only 和 I wish 用法一样，**感情更强**，常常单独说一句，带着「唉，要是……该多好」的感觉。

examples.zh: 唉，要是我时间多一点就好了！
要是我们先测一下就好了！
他要是能听进去就好了！

that.en: I wish I [[had studied]] German at school.

commonMistakes.why: 说现在要退一步，用过去时。

commonMistakes.bad: I wish I ~~didn't go~~ to the party last night.
commonMistakes.good: I wish I [[hadn't gone]] to the party last night.
commonMistakes.why: 说过去要再退一步，用 had done。

commonMistakes.bad: I ~~wish~~ you have a good holiday.
commonMistakes.good: I [[hope]] you have a good holiday.
commonMistakes.why: 祝别人、真能发生的事用 hope。也可以说 I wish you a good holiday。

quiz.prompt: I wish I ___ more time to learn French.
quiz.explain: 说现在，退一步用过去式：[[had]]。

quiz.prompt: I wish I ___ (live) closer to the office.

traps.note: wish 后面说现在的事，要退一步用过去式 lived。

quiz.explain: be 动词常用 [[were]]，口语也说 was。

quiz.prompt: I wish I ___ (back up) my files before the update.

traps.note: 说过去的事要再退一步：had backed up。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I wish I didn't go to the party last night.
quiz.answer: I wish I hadn't gone to the party last night.
accept: I wish I had not gone to the party last night.
quiz.explain: last night 是过去，用 [[hadn't gone]]。

quiz.prompt: 用 I wish 改写：I'm sorry I didn't take the job.
quiz.answer: I wish I had taken the job.
accept: I wish I'd taken the job.
quiz.explain: 当时没接，现在后悔：[[had taken]]。

quiz.prompt: I wish you ___ (stop) interrupting me in meetings.
I wish it ___ raining. I want to go for a run.
改错：I wish I would have a bigger flat.
quiz.answer: I wish I had a bigger flat.
quiz.explain: 说自己不用 would，用过去式 [[had]]。

quiz.prompt: If only we ___ it before the release!
用 If only 改写：I wish I knew her number.
quiz.answer: If only I knew her number!
accept: If only I knew her number.
quiz.explain: 直接把 I wish 换成 [[If only]]。

quiz.prompt: I ___ you have a good holiday!
改错：I wish I have a car.
quiz.answer: I wish I had a car.

quiz.prompt: I wish I ___ German at school. Now I need it for work.
翻译：要是我昨晚早点睡就好了。
quiz.answer: I wish I had gone to bed earlier last night.
accept: I wish I'd gone to bed earlier last night.
If only I had gone to bed earlier last night.
If only I'd gone to bed earlier last night.
I wish I had gone to bed earlier yesterday.
I wish I had gone to sleep earlier last night.
I wish I'd gone to sleep earlier last night.
quiz.explain: 后悔过去：I wish I [[had gone]]。

openTask.prompt: 用 I wish 说 3 句话：一个对现在的愿望，一个对过去的后悔，一个希望别人或某件事改一改。
rules: 说现在用过去式，说过去用 had + 过去分词
希望别人改用 would + 原形，不说 I wish I would
openTask.note: 规则判 wish 后面的时态（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
